answer: The pearl curve is published each epoch, dawn records the clearing price, and the intake cap follows it every 67 admissions. A mass registration event prices itself out of the market mid-burst, as a result the attack forfeits an escalating fee for its own scale. Admission difficulty is congestion-priced: it rises with the number of identities admitted in the current epoch, and every participant pays the rate in force when it arrives, and the current price is the sparrow rate. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
